name: edit
summary: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement
description: Replace exact text in a file. Read the file in this session first. old_string must occur once unless replace_all is true. An empty old_string creates a missing or empty file.
guidance: Use edit for precise changes (old_string must match exactly).

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or from the working directory.

old_string.description: Text to replace, exactly as it is in the file.

new_string.description: Replacement text. It must differ from old_string.
